baseline.gallery: unchanged exact production gallery; expansion evaluated separately

primary_objective: all-query raw localization within 100m, then within 50m, within 25m, catastrophic rate, median and p90 error

required_metrics.positive_rank: complete-gallery first positive, histogram and quantiles; no-positive mass explicit, never dropped from recall denominator
required_metrics.product: maximize empirical answer rate at conditional within100m >=0.90; tied confidence scores inseparable; accepted gt500m rate and median/p90; uncertainty and denominators always reported
required_metrics.failures: retain every eligible query; missing predictions count as raw failures and infinite error; abstention never improves raw metrics

data.historical_tests: v1/v2/v3/v4 and probe permanently opened; historical reporting only, not selection
data.exploration: historical development only plus newly assigned development; historical calibration is not new calibration
data.new_queries: real decodable Moscow street photos, no nearby-positive requirement, no model-score or confidence filtering
data.query_provenance: whole provider sequence/session and exact/near-image duplicate exclusion from all historical galleries, embeddings and queries; photographer holdout where metadata permits
data.new_splits: deterministic spatial blocks with >=250m cross-split embargo and whole capture-sequence assignment, before inference; seed 20260905
data.sampling: record source-frame population and inclusion/exclusion counts; report area/provider strata and coverage-zero queries; provider imagery is a proxy for user-uploaded photos, not an unbiased citywide sample
data.gallery_acquisition: predeclared whole-AOI coverage/density/heading/sequence/time diversity strategy independent of calibration or test coordinates and outcomes; never use query sequences
data.contamination: audit upstream checkpoint training sources, especially MSLS Moscow; unknown foundation pretraining exposure is disclosed; MSLS cannot be a clean final test without contamination clearance
data.test_sealing: private manifest and image access through fixed one-shot ledger; public hashes/counts only, no retrieval/embedding/qualitative inspection until freeze

data_hypothesis: production versus expanded gallery with same SAGE
random versus diversity-balanced reference sampling at matched gallery sizes
coverage ceiling versus retrieval miss versus mode-selection loss
architecture_hypothesis: official diverse retrievers including new untested checkpoints
learned mode selection optimizing coordinates rather than abstention
local geometric matching on deep candidate pools
development-only metric adaptation or fine-tuning if justified
search.factorial: same queries: baseline model/old gallery; baseline model/new gallery; candidate model/old gallery; candidate model/new gallery
search.validation: geographically grouped outer folds, fit transforms only on training folds; inner folds for learned hyperparameters/thresholds; OOF product curves labeled exploratory, not calibrated final performance
search.selection: raw within100m first; development-fold consistency and paired geographic bootstrap; no small-stratum hard veto; at most one architecture goes to new calibration
search.stopping: resolve both hypotheses and test complementary model, data, fusion, preprocessing, mode-selection and verification families; document unavailable or nondeployable methods and measured diminishing returns

freeze.architecture_before_calibration: hash code, dependencies, checkpoint, preprocessing, gallery/index, learned parameters and confidence family; calibration selects numeric threshold only
freeze.before_test: hash both baseline and single candidate, all artifacts, calibration threshold and selection report; exactly one baseline/candidate test transaction
freeze.after_test: no tuning, alternate winner selection, threshold optimization or test redefinition; diagnostic test precision-coverage oracle forbidden

promotion.product: nonzero accepted count, frozen-threshold empirical conditional100m >=0.90 and answer rate no worse than exact baseline; confidence intervals reported, not guarantees
promotion.licensing: official source/checkpoint hash and separate code, weights, dependencies, imagery terms audited; unresolved production rights exclude promotion
promotion.deployment: CPU or available accelerator smoke, deterministic independent-image descriptors, bounded memory/latency, tests, artifact manifest and rollback
promotion.on_failure: keep production intact; publish honest negative result, no fabricated improvement
